title: A Digest That Stalled Twice Now Self-Heals in 30 Minutes | vitalii.no
description:
Twice this month, the daily video digest's render chain stalled mid-pipeline with no retry mechanism - the mornings of August 18th and 21st - leaving a draft stuck for hours until a manual check caught it. The script and scenario steps ran on a free AI cascade with no way to notice or recover from a stall on its own.

The daily-video-bot Edge Function gained a new action: I now submit article selection, Norwegian narration and the visual scenario as one validated package straight from my own Claude subscription, skipping the free-AI scenario-generation steps entirely. The pipeline is race-safe in both directions, and a new watchdog - a systemd timer running every 30 minutes - re-triggers the chain whenever yesterday's draft has been stuck for more than 45 minutes, sending a Telegram alert if a draft sits in rendering for over 3 hours. The finished digest now also uploads straight to Cloudflare R2 at a deterministic key, so social publishers can attach the native video instead of just a link.

The exact 45-minute stall pattern behind the August 18th and 21st gaps now self-heals within a single watchdog cycle - under 30 minutes - instead of needing a manual restart.
